name: usage-limits
description: A slim band above the prompt with your plan's usage limits: the 5-hour window and the week, how much is used, when each resets, and whether your pace will hit the limit before then. Alerts at 75% and 90% and when the pace runs ahead.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language before any flag is picked; the flag in the unfolded band (US, FR, ES) sets it and is remembered across sessions. auto follows Claude Code's language setting (French or Spanish when it is, else English); en, fr or es picks one

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: on shows a toast once per window at 75% and 90% used, and when the pace will reach the limit before the reset; off shows none
